description: Use what the project's camera shows NOW, in the user's open R3 editor, as the project's picture: the image on its Projects card and on its preview link. The editor waits until the scene's textures have loaded and takes it without edit aids (no grid, gizmos or outlines), as a visitor sees it; the answer is the picture it set. Call it once the project looks right (r3_editor_capture first to check), or when the user asks for a new picture. A live page keeps the picture of its live release until the next publish. Needs a tab with the project open and project:write.

projectId.description: A project open in the user's editor (r3_whoami lists them).

name: r3_editor_set_preview_image

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.
